Album of Boxberg containing 15 different views and a short history (fold-out leporello).

Date range: Before 1909

Contains postcards: view of the town at the time of the 1523 fire (drawing); fire of 14 June 1523 (drawing) and monuments of the von Rosenbergs in the Protestant church (photograph); Bocksberg 1645 (engraving); Boxberg 1845 (drawing); Boxberg ruins 1848 (possibly an engraving) and 1908 (photograph); Schulzenkreuz and remains of the gallows (photographs); view of the town from Galgenberg (photograph); view of Wölchingen (photograph); town wall by the Catholic church and Schmiedtor (photographs); main street with the Grand Duke monument and war memorial (photograph); main street with town hall (photograph); main street with district court (photograph); main street with Catholic church (photograph); interior of the Catholic church (photograph); Wölchingen, Protestant church, and church interior (photographs). A short history of the town is on the reverse.

Format: volume, 9.5 × 15 cm
